purpose: Executable ledger for the `formal-proof-assumption-coverage` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Formalization coverage is coverage of a declared fragment, not coverage of a whole candidate. Kernel-checked fragments, proof certificates, and mechanized derivations remain bounded by assumptions, definitions, library boundaries, public-record bridges, and route-state ceilings.

formalization_rows.formalized_fragment: Name the exact formalized theorem, derivation fragment, proof script, checker certificate, statistical specification, or benchmark contract; otherwise coverage is illustrative only.
formalization_rows.informal_remainder: List unformalized physics assumptions, imported lemmas, dictionary translations, solver outputs, numerical reductions, experimental inferences, and public-record mappings left outside the checked fragment.
formalization_rows.kernel_or_checker_trust_base: Declare trusted kernel/checker, axioms, libraries, tactics/automation reconstruction policy, certificate checker, or reviewer-only fallback.
formalization_rows.library_or_axiom_boundary: Separate route-native definitions from imported libraries, axioms, public bridges, observed-sector assumptions, and candidate-external mathematical infrastructure.
formalization_rows.portability_or_translation_limit: A formalized fragment does not automatically transfer across proof assistants, equivalent presentations, physical regimes, candidate families, or public-record targets.
